title: Delivery Deadlines & Shipping Schedules: Prepositions of Time
workplace_track: Export Logistics & Incoterms 2020 (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DDP)
description: Specify vehicle dispatch dates, shipping milestones, and factory handover deadlines using prepositions of time.
learning_objectives: Use prepositions of time: in, on, at, by, within
Distinguish deadline 'by Friday' from duration 'in two weeks'
Communicate contract delivery dates without Czech interference

questions.prompt: All five chassis units will be ready for railway dispatch _____ October 24th.

explanations.correct: Specific calendar dates take preposition 'on': 'on October 24th'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'in' is used for months or years without specific dates.
explanations.wrong_C: 'at' is used for specific times of day.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'dne 24. října'. Specific dates take 'on': 'on October 24th'.

questions.prompt: The customer requires final delivery _____ the end of the fourth quarter.

explanations.correct: Deadline marker ('no later than') takes 'by': 'by the end of Q4'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'at' indicates a point in time, not a deadline limit.
explanations.wrong_B: 'in' means inside the period, not a strict deadline.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'nejpozději do konce 4. čtvrtletí'. Deadlines (no later than) take 'by'.

questions.prompt: The international transport vessel departs from Hamburg port _____ 16:30.

explanations.wrong_D: 'by' indicates a deadline, not a scheduled departure time.

questions.prompt: Production of the custom military tippers will commence _____ June 2027.

explanations.correct: Months and years without specific calendar days take 'in': 'in June 2027'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'v červnu 2027'. Months and years take 'in'.

questions.prompt: The technical handover inspection will take place _____ Monday morning.

explanations.correct: Days of the week and parts of specific days take 'on': 'on Monday morning'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'in' is used for non-specific mornings ('in the morning'), but specific days take 'on'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'v pondělí ráno'. Days of the week take 'on': 'on Monday morning'.

questions.prompt: The client must submit formal acceptance documents _____ 30 calendar days of delivery.

explanations.correct: Time limit/window within which an action must happen takes 'within': 'within 30 days'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'during' describes simultaneous action, not a deadline limit.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'do 30 dnů / ve lhůtě 30 dnů'. Time window takes 'within 30 calendar days'.

questions.prompt: The international sales office is closed _____ public holidays in the Czech Republic.

explanations.correct: Holidays and named days take 'on': 'on public holidays'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'at' is used for periods like 'at Christmas', but 'holidays' takes 'on'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'o státních svátcích'. Plural holiday days take 'on public holidays'.

questions.prompt: Please ensure the signed export declaration arrives _____ 17:00 tomorrow at the latest.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'nejpozději do zítřejších 17:00'. Strict deadline takes 'by'.

questions.prompt: The sea voyage from Antwerp to Alexandria typically takes _____ three weeks.

explanations.correct: Approximation of duration takes 'around' (or 'about'): 'around three weeks'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'in three weeks' means three weeks from now.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'přibližně tři týdny'. Approximate duration takes 'around / about three weeks'.

questions.prompt: The factory warranty coverage begins _____ the date of formal vehicle handover.

explanations.correct: Preposition for dates/calendar days is 'on': 'on the date of handover' (or 'from the date', but 'on the date' specifies the effective start date).
explanations.wrong_D: 'from' is informal compared to 'on the date of'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'dnem předání vozidla'. Formal effective date phrase: 'on the date of vehicle handover'.
